PM Modi flags off first train on Udaipur-Dhar rail line

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will flag off the first train on the Udaipur-Dhar rail line today, connecting the region to the national network. The new track, spanning 16 kilometers, is the first significant rail development in the area since India's independence. While the train will run on the newly laid track, the city of Dhar itself remains 46 kilometers away from the station.
